items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 56:1
items.html: Before the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, the Sefirot of the seven lower Sefirot were separated from one another, one above the other. That is, each one more refined than its fellow was higher. And it is known that disparity of form separates spiritual things, and they are therefore discerned as separate. However, after the bottom Hey ascended to the Einayim, and the coarseness of Malchut was included in every single Sefira up to Hochma, and she became the discernment of the left line in all ten Sefirot together — as against the very essence of the Sefirot, which became the right line, as is known — and afterwards, through the coupling of the upper light, the middle line descended and decided between them, it follows that all ten Sefirot were bound together and corrected in a single coupling by the middle line, in the secret of the single authority. By this, all the seven lower Sefirot became bound and corrected one with another, as a single discernment. And this is what is called the correction of the three lines. (Page 869, Item 9).
